supersedes: skills-resource-profile.json open automatic skills discovery/ignore and reload descriptor prerequisites only. Host integration and resource generation publication remain open.
apis: SkillDiscoveryRequest supplies UserAgentDirectory/ProjectWorkingDirectory grants, ExplicitPaths and IncludeDefaults
SkillDiscovery.BuildSelections derives only granted user/skills and project/.pi/skills; defaults user then project then explicit paths
SkillDiscovery.LoadAsync returns SkillResourceSet; SkillCliBinding.LoadDiscoveredAsync is an unwired borrowed host adapter
SkillPathSelection.Scope and ReportMissingPath are additive init properties; existing explicit callers retain temporary scope and missing diagnostics
SkillResourceSet.ReloadDescriptors contains Key/Fingerprint/Skill; host maps kind skill to ResourceReloadEntry without an Extensions dependency
behavior: Missing conventional roots silent; untrusted roots denied before filesystem calls; no environment/home lookup or authority upgrade
IncludeDefaults false reclassifies explicit paths under supplied default roots as user/project; ordinary explicit selections remain temporary
Read same-directory .gitignore then .ignore then .fdignore before enumeration; selected explicit files bypass adjacent ignore files
Shared per-root matcher receives nested directory prefixes and applies ordered case-insensitive matching, negation and excluded-parent pruning
Preserve source prefix quirks: root /foo loses anchoring; root escaped bang becomes library negation; nested bare foo becomes child/foo
Ignored SKILL.md does not stop traversal; admitted SKILL.md stops even if metadata invalid; root-only regular md, nested SKILL.md, hidden/node_modules skips preserved

Ignore reads share MaximumFiles and MaximumTotalBytes with skill reads; failed reads consume supplied byte allowance; failed enumerations reserve aggregate allowance before borrowing and never reuse it
Fresh expansion validates fresh YAML with borrowed decoder and keeps captured identity; malformed YAML returns exact raw command plus fixed diagnostic
Reload keys hash normalized selected path; fingerprints hash captured raw bytes and metadata/provenance, including body-only changes; no extra reads
Cancellation directly awaits original borrowed reads; no spawned tasks, leases, process/model/tool grants or disposal authority
limitsAndDifferences: Default limits 128 read attempts/selections, 4096 directory entries, depth16, 64KiB file and 1MiB aggregate bytes; ignore files consume read attempts too
Ignore matcher max4096 rules and max4096 characters per prefixed pattern; longer/invalid bounded input produces fixed diagnostics rather than an unrestricted scan
Native physical reader rejects links and link ancestors, Windows network/device paths; upstream follows links. This is a bounded authorized-root profile, not a filesystem race sandbox

Lexical normalization/dedup, fixed diagnostic text/order, conservative failed budgets, bounded Unicode regex casing and malformed class grammar remain native profile limits requiring genuine source comparison
Directory traversal keeps filesystem entry order and a per-selection matcher; no sorting or automatic parent ignore lookup
Ignore I/O/matcher failures diagnose and continue with already admitted rules; upstream ignore read errors are silent
Descriptors identify discovery captures, not an immutable execution lease; fresh expansion still rereads selected files. Caller must fence generations and join old expansions before retirement
